_comment: What every combat action LOOKS like (client only; the rules never read this). Each action key maps to a list of layers that play together. Adding or changing an effect is a data change here. KEYS: 'swing/<move id>' (the move's damaging frames begin; falls back to 'swing/<kind>' such as swing/light_1, swing/heavy, swing/run_light, then 'swing/default'), 'windup/<move id or kind>' (the move starts: skills and telegraphed monster moves), 'land/<move id or kind>' (a diving move touches the ground), 'hit' (+ 'hit/heavy', 'hit/crit', 'hit/launch', 'hit/knockback', 'hit/armored' and 'hit/<move id or kind>' when they apply, see hit_rules), 'block', 'guard_break', 'poise_break', 'dodge', 'run_dust', 'land', 'knockdown', 'getup', 'death', 'loot', 'rest', 'status/<effect control or kind>'. LAYERS: type trail (a brush stroke: shape arc/thrust/ring, radius, width, from/to = degrees from the facing for arcs or distances along it for thrusts, rise = [height at start, height at end], tilt = roll of the stroke plane in degrees, yaw = extra turn, sweep = part of the life the head needs to cross the stroke, tail = visible tail length, lanes/lane_gap = parallel copies), sprite (mode glow/star/splat/ring/beam/swirl/ghost/cross, size = [from, to], height = stretch upward, billboard camera/y/ground, spin = degrees per second, spikes), ground (mode ring/crack/stain/glyph, size = [from, to]), burst (one draw call of up to 32 particles: style streak/puff/mote, count, speed, spread = cone half angle in degrees, dir up/down/forward/back/none, lift = degrees above the ground for forward/back, gravity, drag, size, streak), ghosts (afterimages along a moving fighter: count, interval), shake (strength, seconds), punch (degrees of zoom), flash (screen color). COMMON: seconds, delay, color (a palette name, 'weapon' = the attacker's color / the item tier, '#rrggbb', or [r, g, b, a]), ink (0 = pure color, 1 = dark ink), anchor (at = the action's point, feet, chest, hitbox), offset = [forward, up, side], scale = true to grow with the hit's damage (see hit_rules: count and shake grow by the factor, size and speed by its square root), opacity. 'base' = also play all layers of another key first.
_skill_comment: Per-skill looks (all optional): 'skill_cast/<skill>' on the caster as the cast starts, 'skill_burst/<skill>' where the skill's own visual lands (the burst point; for a beam 'at' is its start and anchor 'end' its far end, and a sprite with link true is stretched between them), 'skill_trail/<skill>' left behind a flying projectile or along a ground zone, 'skill_struck/<skill>' on each target the skill hits (for skills whose own visual does not land on the target). SKILL TREE hits (client/stage_view.gd): 'skill_hit/<tier 1-3>' sparks on every struck target, 'skill_hit/crit' on crits, 'skill_hit/tick' for periodic ground/totem hits, 'skill_dot' for burn/bleed ticks, 'skill_impact/<tier>'  'skill_impact/crit' = camera only (shake/punch/flash), played once per frame and only when the local player cast or took the hit. The tier comes from the rules (data/skill_system/integration.json 'impact'). 'skill_gem/<effect gem id>' plays on the target when a hit carries that effect gem (thorns/regen play on the caster at cast). 'weapon' color in skill keys = skill_colors[skill].

violence._comment: Violent light-and-scatter looks (client/vfx/violence.gd + client/vfx/violent_vfx.gd; Boss 2026-11-19: L3 light approved, no ground rings/scorch, no dim, no hit-stop, rolled out to every race ultimate, class skill and the mummy bosses' big moves). level = the ONE token: current (off) | L1 | L2 | L3. presets = actions violent/<preset>/<level> and the lighter _phone twin (phones, slow devices). skills: key -> preset, color (= 'weapon' in its layers), scale (size and shake), on (release | impact for class skills; active | area | shot | wave for monsters), at (caster | target), ahead (metres along the facing). map_colors: debris / dust colours by map id prefix (the dark mummy floor needs light sand; orc = the night camp's dark earth, a lighter grit and grey-violet smoke so it still reads on the night-blue floor; elder_grove = rotting-wood brown chunks, moss-green grit and a pale green-gold dust over the mossy loam). summoners: enemy types whose arrival plays monster/summon. glow: true on a layer = additive light (never inked); inked: false = no ink pass (soft smoke).
